> SUG is a speculative proposal that has not been empirically validated. Please
> distinguish its assumptions and mathematical consequences from established
> physical results and observational evidence.

## Topic

Which postulate, equation, prediction, or open question is the discussion about?
Link the relevant paper section if possible.

## Question or argument

State the question, criticism, or proposed interpretation as clearly as
possible.

## Reasoning and assumptions

Show the key steps of a derivation or explain the assumptions on which the
argument depends. Define symbols and specify domains, units, and reference
scales as applicable.

## Evidence or references

Provide citations, data, calculations, or reproducible code supporting the
point. Clarify whether material is theoretical, simulated, or observational.

## Possible test or falsification

What measurable result would support or reject the claim? If no practical test
is currently known, note what makes one difficult.

## Related questions

List relevant open questions, predictions, or existing discussions.
